season.evidence: Web search: Mountaineers lists May-Oct season with road possibly not open before late May; notes bugs in midsummer and larch color Sep-Oct. Logged successes peak Aug-Oct (45/76/97). Stored text: snow lingers into July.

track.why: Logged as East Face/Upper Eagle Lake from Crater Creek; the report describes climbing the east face above Upper Eagle Lake, summit 18 m from our pin, and descending SE slopes. Matches our East Face line via Upper Eagle Lake. Mid-June is within a month of the window and inside the stored late May-Oct season.

facts.text: The south and southeast gullies and slopes below the summit are loose gravel and slab: in mid June a slab layer slid free near 7,400 ft, and in August the gully south of the top was slow going. Descend one at a time and do not stand below a partner.
